book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Farsaawetanne Muse Wogaa Tamaarsizayta Kadhides
Qasseka Yesusi derezassinne bana kaallizaytas,
«Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytinne Farsaaweti Muse wombora bolla uttida.
Hessa gishshas istti inttes yootizayssa ubbaa ooththitenne naagite; gido attiin istti doonan haasayzayssa mala ooson bessontta gishshas intte istta ooso kaallofte.
«Hessaththoka asi tookkanaas dandayontta deexo tooho qachchidi asa hashe bolla woththeettes; baas gidikko biradhdhe xeerankka bochchettenna.

Istta ooso ubbaa asi beyana mala ooththeettes; ba ashenkitaabe Geeshsha Maxaafa giddofe xaafi ekkida issi issi xiqiseta kitabe sikkidi liiphe bolla woykko kushen qachchizaaz ooththeettes. Ba may7o macara adusseettes.
Diggisay dizason bonchchoso Ayhuda Woosa Keeththankka sinththara uttana doseettes.
Hessaththoka giya giddon saro geetettanaassinne asay istta, ‹Astamaaree!› gaana mala koyeettes.
«Intte gidikko, ‹Astamaare› geetetti xeygettofte; intte Astamaarey issaa xalala gidishin intte wurikka issoy issaas ishantta.
Salon inttes issi Aaway xalala diza gishshas biitta bolla oonakka, ‹Aawawu!› gi xeygopite.
Intte astamaarey issi Kirstoosa xalla gidida gishshas intte, ‹Astamaarentoo!› geetettofte.
Intte giddon ubbaafe aadhdhizaadey inttes ooththizaade gidana.
Bana dhoqqisizaadey kawuyana; bana kawushshizaadey bonchchettana.

«Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo, Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytoo! Intteno Farsaawetoo! Asay Xoossa kawoteth gelontta mala asa bolla intte penge gordiza gishshas inttena aayye ana! Intte inttes gelekketanne gelanaas koyzaytakka gelththeketa.

Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo! Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytoo, qasseka Farsaawetoo! Inttes aayye ana! Azinay baynda maccassata keeth kallosishe asa ayfe sinththan adussa woosa intte woossiza gishshas intte iita pirda pirdettana.

«Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo! Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytoo! Qasseka Farsaawetoo! Issi as Ayhuda ammanon gelththanaas abba bollaranne biitta bollara yuuyi daaburdinne ammanththida asaa inttefe nam7u kushe aaththidi Gaanname naa intte kessiza gishshas inttes aayye ana!

«Intteno Inttes qooqi uttidi harata kaaleththizaytoo! Inttes aayye ana! ‹Oonikka Xoossa Keeththan caaqqiko aykkoy baa› gido attiin, ‹Xoossa Keeththa giddon diza worqqan caaqqiko caaqo gomey gakkana› geeta.
Intteno qooqidaytoo! Balettidaytoo! Worqqafenne worqqa dummasida Xoossa Keeththafe awayssi aadhdhizee?
Hessaththoka, ‹Oonikka yarsho
yarshizaso bolla caaqqiko aykkoy baa; gido attiin yarshizason diza yarshoza bolla caaqqiko caaqoy gomees› geeta.
Intteno qooqetoo! Yarshofenne yarsho shiishshizasoppe awayssee aadhdhizay?
Hessa gishshas yarsho shiishshizaso bolla caaqqizaadey yarshosoza bollanne yarshizaso bolla diza ubba miishshan caaqqees.
Hessaththoka Xoossa Keeththaza bolla caaqqiday Xoossa Keeththaninne iza giddon aqizayssan caaqqees.
Salon caaqizaadeyka Xoossa alganinne alga bolla uttidayssan caaqqees.

«Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo, Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytoo, Farsaawetoo! Inttes aayye ana! Aasutappe, aanugappenne katkal7afe tammaafe issino immeeta; gido attiin wogatappe waannatizayta heytikka tuma pirda, maaroteththinne ammaneteth gidikko kadhideta. Heyta aggontta dishe haytantta intte ooththanaas inttes bessees shin aggideta.
Intteno qooqi uttidi kaaleththizaytoo! Uu7e gaccidi uyeeta shin gaamella muume mitteeta!

«Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo, Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytonne Farsaawetoo! Inttes aayye ana! Xuu7assinne keres bolla bagga qucceeta shin iza giddon dizayssa intte bonqqaninne uuzeteththan shiishshideta.
Nenoo qooqe Farsaawezoo! Koyrottada xuu7assinne keres giddo bagga geeshsha! Hessafe guye kare baggay geesh gidana.

«Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo, Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytoo, qasse Farsaawetoo! Bolla baggay nooran meeshettidi lo7izayti giddoy gidikko hayqqidayta meqeththinne daro tunateththan kumida duufota misatiza gishshas inttes aayye ana!
Intteka bolla baggara asas xillo asata misateeta; intte giddoy gidikko cimoninne iitateththan kumides.
«Intteno doonan cimmizaytoo! Muse wogaa astamaaretoo, qasseka Farsaawetoo! Inttes aayye ana! Nabeta duufo lo7eththizaytoo! Xillo asata duufo hawultera giigsizaytoo!
Nu aawati nabeta wodhiza wode nu dizaakko isttara zuppetokko shin,
intte nabeta wodhida asata nayta gididayssa intte doonara intterkka intte intte bolla markkatteeta.
Histtiko oosettidi polettontta oge bolla diza intte aawata ooso polite.
«Intteno dukkiza iita shooshsha naytoo! Gaanname tama pirdafe intte waani attanee?

Hessa gishshas nabetanne eranchchata astamaaretakka ta inttes yeddana. Intte istta giddofe issi issi asata wodhana. Baggayta intte kaqqana; baggayta intte Ayhuda Woosa Keeththan garafananne he katamappe hara katama intte gooddana.

Hessa gishshas xillo Aabeele suuththaafe haa simmiin Xoossa Keeththaninne yarsho yarshizaso giddon intte wodhida Baarakiyo naa Zakaraasa suuththaa gakkanaas biitta bolla gukkida xillota suuththa ubbaas intte oyshettana.
Ta inttes tumu gays; kase aadhdhida yo7o ubbaas hayssi ha yeletay oyshettana.

«Hanne Yerusalaamee! Nabeta wodhizaaree! Neekko kiitettidayta shuchchara caddizaaree! Hanne Yerusalaame, kutto aaya ba ciyeta ba qefe giddo shiishshiza mala ta ne nayta shiishshanaas aappun wode koyadinaashin ne gidikko koyabeekka.
Hekko intte keeththi kays gidi attana.
Ta inttes tumu gays; intte Godaa sunththan yizaadey anjjettidaade gaana wodey gakkanaas nam7anththo tana beyekketa» gides.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo tammanne oyddu bolla diza qofa gujjeettes; qofazikka Marqoosan shempo 12:40 dizayssa misatees.
Yarsho: Yarsho asi ba godaas giidi ooththiza oosoy wuri yarsho geetettees.
